page.overview:
Who is Neptune?

King Neptune is a merman and the king of the Ryugu Kingdom on Fish-Man Island. He is also the current patriarch of the Neptune Family, father of Fukaboshi, Ryuboshi, Manboshi, and Shirahoshi, and the husband of the late Queen Otohime.

Neptune is a giant-sized and muscular merman. He has a red nose, small eyes, and long, thick, orange, curly hair (despite his age of seventy) and a beard. Both his chest and arms are covered with hair. He is bare-chested and has matching black tattoos on both arms, which look like spirals with wavy protrusion designs around it.

He wears a gold crown that resembles a tulip with jewels embedded and a golden bracelet on each wrist and carries a gold trident with an elaborate design.

At Otohime's funeral, he wore a large suit. When he and his family arrived at the Red Port for the Levely, he wore a dark-colored coat.
